117540.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Tucson
117540.note: Jewish News of Greater Phoenix (8 Feb 2002): 'In 1984, Rabbi Yossi and Chana Shemtov started Chabad of Tucson.' Arizona Jewish Post (1 May 2025): 'Shemtov has led the congregation since 1984.' The Arizona Jewish Post of 16 Feb 2017 dates their sending to 1983: 'The expansion of Chabad to other cities in Arizona began in 1983, when Rabbi Yossie and Chanie Shemtov were sent by the Rebbe to establish Chabad Tucson and Chabad activities at the University of Arizona.' Kept as 1984, when they began there. At 2443 East 4th Street (Young Israel-Chabad Tucson) today.

157392.name: Arizona Jewish Russian Programs
157392.note: The Jewish News (13 Dec 1996, 'One little candle'): 'Now, Chabad's Rabbi Don Hayman has taken over much of the interchange' with the Valley's Russian immigrants; its calendar of 6 Dec 1996 lists a 'Russian-speaking Hanukkah party' at Chabad of Phoenix, and on 26 Sept 1997 'Rabbi Don Hayman, Russian outreach and program director at the Phoenix Chabad center'. The Jewish News (12 Jan 2001, 'Free to be Jewish'): 'In the four years since the programs' inception, they have served more than 2,000 new Americans.' Both put the start in 1996. Its chabad.org listing went up July 29 2004.

5276310.name: Cteen Phoenix
5276310.note: The Jewish News ('Valley View', 5 Aug 2011, 'Chabad hires rabbi for new teen program'): 'Chabad of Arizona has hired Rabbi Dov Levertov to run C-Teen, a program for Jewish teens throughout the Valley'; 'The kickoff event will be at 4 p.m. Sunday, Aug. 21'. The same program after: CTEEN at Chabad of Phoenix, 2110 E. Lincoln Drive (Jewish News, Oct 2013); with Rabbi Tzvi Rimler by Dec 2017 (Jewish News, Feb 2018); this listing (the Rimlers, 2110 E Lincoln Drive) went up Oct 12 2021; 'Rabbi Tzvi Rimler, director of CTeen Phoenix' (Jewish News, 12 March 2026).

5607924.name: Chabad House at the University of Arizona
5607924.note: Arizona Jewish Post (on CrownHeights.info, 22 June 2006): Rabbi Yossie Winner, 25, 'moved to Tucson last July from Brooklyn with his wife, Naomi, 23, to establish a Chabad House on the University of Arizona campus.' Chabad was 'active on the UA campus in the early 1980s' through Chabad Tucson (Arizona Jewish Post, 14 July 2015). The Winners hosted students in their two-bedroom house and a backyard tent until the Rohr Chabad Jewish Student Center at 1436 E. Drachman, this listing's address, was built (expected to open Dec 2015). This listing went up on Oct 25 2022 and names Rabbi Shmulie and Sarah Shanowitz; the Arizona Daily Star (17 May 2026): 'Rabbi Shmulie Shanowitz, director of the Chabad House on campus'.

earlier.where: the Winners' two-bedroom house and a backyard tent, near Euclid Avenue and Speedway Boulevard, Tucson

4927362.name: Chabad of Casa Grande
4927362.note: COLlive (25 Jan 2021): 'Rabbi Moshe and Chaya Sasonkin (nee Bigelman) were appointed as the first Shluchim to Casa Grande'; 'the Sasonkis say they are looking forward to moving down there'. Casa Grande Dispatch (7 May 2021): 'Rabbi Moshe Sasonkin and his wife Chaya recently moved to Casa Grande and are hoping to connect with the area Jewish community.' So they moved in early 2021; ChabadInfo (25 Jan 2021): 'After visiting Casa Grande, AZ in 2020 Rabbi Moshe & Chaya Sasonkin decided to relocate and establish a Chabad Center'. Its chabad.org listing went up earlier, on Nov 10 2020.

5529178.name: Chabad Israeli Center
5529178.note: COLlive (15 Dec 2022): 'Rabbi Shneur and Chanie Feigin have established the Chabad Israel Center in Phoenix, which will be serving the Hebrew-speaking population'; 'They arrive with their 3 children.' Its chabad.org listing went up June 16 2022. Now 4523 E Hearn Road.

3590177.name: Chabad of Sedona
3590177.note: Rabbi Mendel and Fraydee Kessler. Its chabad.org listing went up March 13 2017, and the IRS lists 'Chabad Of Sedona Inc' as exempt from May 2017 (ProPublica). COLlive (31 Aug 2018): Kessler, 'who was a chaplain at Ironwood and is now the director of Chabad of Sedona, Arizona'. No report of its opening found; its own site gives no year. Medium: from these records, not a statement. Now 140 Coffee Pot Drive.

1279033.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Goodyear
1279033.note: CrownHeights.info (27 April 2021): 'In 2010 Rabbi Berel and Chana Zaklikofsky made a lifetime commitment to the Jewish community of Goodyear, AZ, founding the Chabad Jewish Center.' The Jewish News ('Valley View', 17 June 2011, 'Chabad opens center in Goodyear'): they 'moved to Arizona from Brooklyn, N.Y., last week to start Chabad Jewish Center of Goodyear'; before that he 'visited Arizona last December to host a menorah-lighting celebration at Goodyear Community Park'. Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 19 2010. Medium: founded 2010 (the listing, the Dec 2010 lighting), opened with the move in June 2011. Now 14295 W La Reata Avenue.
